exposure: Placental three-dimensional power Doppler vascularization indices (vascularization index, flow index, vascularization-flow index)
Pregnancy type (monochorionic-diamniotic twin, dichorionic-diamniotic twin, singular)
cohort: The study participants included normal monochorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies (N=15), normal dichorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies (N=36), and normal singular pregnancies (N=109).
finding: Placental vascularization indices and birth weight were significantly higher in normal singular gestations compared to normal twin pregnancies, and strong linear correlations were found between placental vascularization indices and birth weight in both twin groups.
cross-section timing: At birth (measurements of placental indices, birth weight, and umbilical blood parameters)
birth_weight: Average birth weight was 3377g for singular pregnancies; it was significantly lower in twin pregnancies but specific average values for twin groups were not provided.
gest_age: Average gestational age was 38.2 weeks for singular pregnancies; specific average values for twin pregnancies were not provided.
